description: Compare two to six RoutersUA products side by side: one row per specification the store lists (ports, Wi-Fi, VPN speeds, cellular, battery, power, size, warranty and others), with one value per product in the order given, plus each product's live price in UAH, availability and page URL. Use it when the user weighs models against each other; find candidates first with routersua_search_products, and use routersua_get_product for one product's full description. A null value means the store lists no such specification for that product. An unknown product returns an error naming it and listing valid slugs.

products.description: Two to six products, each a slug or model code as in search results, e.g. ["GL-MT6000", "GL-BE9300"].

name: routersua_compare_products
title: Compare RoutersUA products
